text: Write a C function to concatenate all elements of the given list into a string.

test_cases.expected: hello there have a rocky day
test_cases.assert_src: assert concatenate_elements(['hello','there','have','a','rocky','day'] ) == '  hello there have a rocky day'
assert concatenate_elements([ 'Hi', 'there', 'How','are', 'you'] ) == '  Hi there How are you'

test_cases.expected: Part of the journey is end
test_cases.assert_src: assert concatenate_elements([ 'Part', 'of', 'the','journey', 'is', 'end'] ) == '  Part of the journey is end'
